title: Senior DevOps Architect
description:
**About the Role**

Join SBS as a Senior DevOps Architect for Digital Core, a strategic product portfolio supporting mission-critical banking operations and real-time transaction processing. You will own the platform architecture and engineering practices that turn product innovation into secure, repeatable and operable software across SaaS, public-cloud, private-cloud and customer-controlled environments. The mandate goes beyond tooling: create an industrialised product-delivery platform that improves engineering speed, production resilience, compliance evidence and the economics of operating software at scale.

**This is a senior, high-impact technical leadership role with clear hands-on accountability: you will guide architecture and tackle technical debt, but also use modern enterprise-approved AI tools such as Claude, Codex and equivalent code models to produce deliverable platform components, automation, infrastructure code, pipeline assets and engineering patterns directly.z**

**Why This Role Matters**

Power a strategic product platform. Build the delivery and runtime foundations for Digital Core as SBS expands modular products and SaaS deployments and advances towards a more recurring, scalable software model.

**Operate where reliability has real consequences.**
Engineer platforms for regulated, high-volume and time-critical financial services, including instant and account-to-account payments.

**Make progressive transformation possible.**
Enable banks to introduce modular capabilities and run new repeatable environments, controlled releases and strong operational guardrails.

Create leverage across engineering. Convert security, observability, deployment, compliance and cost-control patterns into reusable self-service capabilities. Improve engineering throughput without trading away resilience, governance or customer choice of deployment model.

**Shape AI-enabled software delivery.**
Operationalise governed use of modern AI models across infrastructure code, pipelines, testing, incident learning and documentation, while retaining deterministic controls and accountable human approval.

**What You Will Do**

**Architect enterprise DevOps platforms.**
Design scalable, reliable and cost-aware architectures across AWS, hybrid and multi-cloud patterns where they create clear value.

**Drive CI/CD excellence.**
Standardise secure delivery pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Argo CD and related tooling, with progressive delivery, rollback and zero-downtime deployment strategies.

**Automate infrastructure.**
Lead infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Ansible, Helm and cloud-native templates. Establish reusable modules, policy controls and automated validation.

**Apply AI-assisted DevOps.**
Use the latest approved AI models to generate and improve pipeline definitions, infrastructure code, policy-as-code, automation scripts, runbooks, test scenarios and architecture documentation.

**Build safe AI workflows.**
Evaluate generated outputs for correctness, security, permissions, destructive actions, cost and maintainability. Protect secrets and confidential data, require peer review, and keep deterministic testing and audit trails.

**Engineer for real-time payments.**
Design deployment, scaling, resilience and recovery patterns for always-on transaction processing, including controlled degradation, idempotency-aware operations and rapid restoration.

**Support flexible deployment.**
Establish common platform patterns across SaaS, public cloud, private cloud and customer-operated environments without fragmenting engineering standards or compliance evidence.

**Champion governance and DevSecOps.**
Define guardrails, standards and controls aligned with GDPR, PCI DSS and PSD2. Integrate security scanning, provenance, approvals and compliance evidence into delivery workflows.

**Lead container platforms.**
Drive Kubernetes and Docker architecture, workload scaling, tenancy, service discovery, Helm packaging and microservices deployment patterns.

**Improve reliability and observability.**
Implement metrics, logs, traces and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK and cloud-native services. Apply SRE practices, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident response and resilience testing.

**Advance platform engineering.**
Create self-service golden paths and paved-road capabilities that improve developer experience while maintaining governance.

**Deliver hands-on technical outcomes.**
Personally design, write, review and ship meaningful platform assets, including infrastructure modules, CI/CD templates, automation scripts, policy checks, runbooks and reference implementations. This is not a hands-off advisory role.

**Lead AI-enabled ways of working.**
Help teams adopt modern AI-assisted engineering practices, including prompt/context design, code generation, review discipline, validation workflows and safe reuse patterns, so the organisation changes how it delivers rather than simply adding new tools.

**Build technical strength around you.**
Hire, coach and raise the bar for a strong group of hands-on technical engineers and architects, creating a culture where senior people lead by producing, pairing, reviewing and teaching—not only by steering from a distance.

**Technology Landscape**

**Cloud and infrastructure:**
AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Helm and other new technologies.

**Delivery and platform:**
GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Argo CD, Docker, Kubernetes and GitOps.

**Observability:**
Prometheus, Grafana, ELK and CloudWatch; OpenTelemetry experience is advantageous.

**Security and governance:**
DevSecOps, policy-as-code, software supply-chain security, secrets management and regulatory controls.

**Automation and development:**
Python, Go and Bash; APIs and event-driven automation.

**AI-enabled engineering:**
Enterprise-approved coding assistants and frontier models, model evaluation, prompt/context design, secure usage patterns and human-in-the-loop review.

**Qualifications**

**Experience:**
10+ years in IT, including 5+ years in DevOps/platform engineering and 3+ years in an architecture role, with evidence of delivering complex distributed platforms.

**Cloud architecture:**
Deep expertise in at least one major cloud platform and strong working knowledge of multi-cloud and hybrid architecture patterns.

**Infrastructure as code:**
Advanced proficiency with Terraform and Ansible, plus Helm and cloud-native infrastructure templates.

**CI/CD and GitOps:**
Proven ability to design secure, reliable and efficient pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins and Argo CD.

**Kubernetes:**
Expertise in Docker and Kubernetes, including cluster architecture, scaling, workload isolation, upgrades and production operations.

**Security and networking:**
Strong grounding in cloud networking, identity, Linux/system administration, hardening and software supply-chain security.

**SRE and operations:**
Experience with observability, incident response, error budgets, capacity planning, resilience engineering and chaos testing.

**AI fluency:**
Hands-on use of current AI models for DevOps design and code generation, with the ability to benchmark outputs and implement approval, testing, privacy and audit controls.

**Hands-on delivery mindset:**
Demonstrated ability to personally produce production-quality technical deliverables while operating at architect level, rather than relying only on recommendations, governance or delegation.

**Change leadership:**
Experience helping engineering teams shift to new operating models, including AI-assisted development, platform engineering, DevSecOps and disciplined technical debt reduction.

**Leadership:**
Strong communication, stakeholder management and mentoring skills, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, operations, security and product teams.

**Certifications:**
Relevant cloud, Kubernetes or DevOps certifications are advantageous, such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, CKA or CKAD.

**Success in This Role**

Success means Digital Core can convert roadmap ideas into production outcomes faster and with greater confidence. You will reduce lead time and operational toil, strengthen availability and recovery, make compliance evidence repeatable, improve cloud and platform cost transparency, and establish responsible AI-assisted delivery as a governed engineering capability. Just as importantly, you will demonstrate hands-on technical leadership: producing deliverables yourself, showing teams how to use new AI tools safely and effectively, helping engineers adapt to new ways of working, and building a stronger technical bench through hiring, coaching and high standards.

title: Vice President ML Ops Engineer
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as Vice President-ML Ops Engineer at Barclays, where you will play a pivotal role to manage operations within a business area and maintain processes with risk management initiatives. You will take ownership of your work and provide first-class support to our clients with expertise and care.
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
To lead the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise-grade ML Ops frameworks that enable scalable, secure, and efficient deployment of AI and Generative AI models, while driving best practices in automation, monitoring, and AWS architecture.
  
  
**Accountabilities Are Given Below**

* Lead and mentor a high‑performing ML Ops engineering team, driving ownership, skill development, and cross‑functional collaboration across Data Science, Engineering, Cloud, and Security.
* Architect and govern scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized AWS platforms (SageMaker, EKS, Lambda, Step Functions) for enterprise ML and GenAI workloads.
* Design and implement automated ML pipelines covering data ingestion, management, feature processing, and high‑throughput model training/inference workflows, ensuring reliable, low‑latency, production‑grade consumption patterns.
* Establish robust data and model governance frameworks, including quality checks, lineage, auditability, and regulatory compliance.
* Build comprehensive model observability and monitoring systems for performance, drift, data quality, latency, and operational health using CloudWatch and custom dashboards.
* Drive security, reliability, and operational excellence, ensuring strong IAM practices, encryption, secrets management, and cloud cost optimization.

**Technical Skills Required For This Role Include**

* Experience in Programming & Automation: Python, Bash, SQL.
* MLOps Tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker Pipelines Cloud Platforms: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch)
* DevOps Expertise: CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Docker, Kubernetes
* Data Management: Enterprise data governance, ETL processes Leadership Skills: Strategic planning, team management, stakeholder communication

The VP-MLOps Engineer role is responsible for leading the design and governance of MLOps frameworks, AWS-based architectures, and automation strategies to enable efficient, secure, and scalable deployment of AI and Generative AI models.
  
  
This role requires a flexible working approach, ensuring availability during select hours that overlap with US-based partners and stakeholders.
  
  
You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Noida.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop and lead the execution of business unit/function data strategy, ensuring the effective and efficient use of data to drive informed decision-making, support regulatory and control requirements, improve operational efficiency, and generate business value.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Definition and oversight of data governance and procedures to address control and regulatory requirements, including Data Privacy.
* Definition and oversight of data analytics and insights that support the effective management of the business and well as driving commercial outcomes.
* Development of a team of data professionals with expertise in data analytics, data engineering, data science, and other relevant disciplines.
* Analysis of the bank's current data landscape, identify key data assets and gaps, and develop a roadmap for future data initiatives.
* Monitoring team performance and setting clear performance expectations.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.
* The role is responsible for leading the design and governance of MLOps frameworks, AWS-based architectures, and automation strategies to enable efficient, secure, and scalable deployment of AI and Generative AI models

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Tech S and T -Resilience And Reliability Architect-Manager-GDSF02

* Thread dump, heap dump generation & analysis

title: Head of SRE & Production Engineering
description:
**Job Description: Head of SRE & Production Engineering**

Location: Noida, India

Experience: 10–15 years

Employment: Full-time

Reporting to: VP Engineering

**About PayRange**

PayRange is a technology company building software and payment solutions for the unattended retail and laundry industry. Our platform supports business-critical operations across multiple locations, applications, integrations and payment systems.

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader to establish and lead our 24/7 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Production Operations function in Noida.

**Role overview**

This is a build-from-scratch leadership role. You will be responsible for designing the operating model, establishing monitoring and observability, implementing incident management practices, building the team and ensuring the reliability, availability and performance of our production systems.

The role combines SRE, cloud infrastructure engineering, application operations, production support and incident management.

**Key Responsibilities**

-
Build and Lead the Team: Build and manage a 24/7 production operations team of 7–8 engineers, including shift planning, on-call rotations and escalation processes.

-
Infrastructure & Application Reliability: Own the reliability and performance of AWS infrastructure, applications, databases, APIs and third-party integrations.

-
Monitoring & Observability: Establish centralized monitoring, dashboards, alerts and health checks using tools such as New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog or CloudWatch.

-
Incident Management: Lead production incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), postmortems and preventive actions.

-
Proactive Monitoring: Identify performance degradation, infrastructure bottlenecks and unusual application behaviour before they affect customers.

-
Payment & Customer Monitoring: Establish monitoring for payment failures, unusual transaction patterns, refunds and changes in customer activity. Coordinate with Payments, Engineering, Security and Customer Success teams on potential issues.

-
Automation & Operational Excellence: Automate operational tasks, improve incident response and establish SRE practices around availability, SLIs and SLOs.

**Required Skills & Experience**

-
10–15 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure or Production Engineering.

-
3–5 years of experience leading engineering or production operations teams.

-
Strong hands-on experience with AWS, particularly EC2, RDS, VPC, IAM and CloudWatch.

-
Strong understanding of Linux, networking, MySQL, Redis, APIs and distributed systems.

-
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog or ELK.

-
Scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash or similar.

-
Experience managing production incidents, on-call operations and 24/7 teams.

Good to Have

-
Experience with payment systems, fintech or transaction monitoring.

-
Experience with high-availability SaaS platforms.

-
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and CI/CD.

-
Experience building an SRE or NOC team from scratch.

**What We Are Looking For**

A hands-on engineering leader who can build a team from the ground up, troubleshoot complex production issues and establish a proactive operations culture. Someone who focuses on preventing incidents, improving system reliability and continuously automating operational processes.

**First 90 Days: Expected Outcomes**

-
Assess existing infrastructure, applications and monitoring.

-
Build the team structure and define 24/7 shift coverage.

-
Establish centralized monitoring, dashboards and alerting.

-
Implement incident management, escalation procedures and runbooks.

-
Introduce proactive infrastructure, payment and customer activity monitoring.

title: Senior Storage Engineer
description:
**About Us**
At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure-to-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here.
  
  
And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation.
  
  
Read more about apexanalytix - https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/
  
  
Most storage jobs are console administration: provision a LUN, hand it over, close the ticket. This one is not. We build, own and operate our own private cloud on our own hardware, and storage runs the whole way from the enterprise arrays through Ceph to the persistent volume a container actually mounts. You would own that path end to end, and you would own the thing most organisations only claim to have, which is a restore that has been proven rather than assumed.
  
  
What you would own
  
  

* Kubernetes-native storage. Rook and Ceph, the CSI layer, StorageClasses, and how a persistent volume claim becomes real capacity. This is the centre of the role, not an adjunct to it.
* Provable backup and restore. Not just that backups ran, but that a restore has been performed, timed and witnessed. You would own the evidence, and the schedule that keeps it current.
* The enterprise arrays. Pure Storage and NetApp, including snapshots, replication, provisioning, capacity planning and performance work.
* Disaster recovery. Designing the tests, running them, and fixing what they expose. RPO and RTO you can defend with a number rather than an intention.
* The storage standard. Documentation, monitoring, alerting on failure rather than on absence of success, and the capacity roadmap.

What the first year looks like
  
  

* Establish provable backup and restore across every tenant and platform system, with independently witnessed evidence. This is a stated company priority, and it would be yours.
* Bring Ceph and the Kubernetes storage layer under the same operational standard as the arrays.
* Run at least one full DR exercise end to end and close what it uncovers.
* Remove the single points of knowledge, so no part of the storage estate depends on one person being reachable.

What we need you to have done
  
  
**Two Hard Requirements For This Role.**

* Kubernetes storage, hands-on in production. Rook and Ceph, or a CSI driver you have operated. You should be able to explain what happens between a persistent volume claim and real capacity, and describe a time it did not work and how you found out why. Provisioning storage and handing it to a Kubernetes team does not meet this bar.
* Restores you have personally performed. Not backup jobs you monitored. An actual restore, that you ran, recently, and can tell us how long it took and what came back. A backup nobody has restored is not a backup, and this is the first thing we will ask about.
* Hands-on Kubernetes storage in production. Rook and Ceph, or an equivalent CSI-based platform. Persistent volumes, StorageClasses, and the boundary between cluster storage and physical capacity.
* 8+ years in storage and data protection, across both enterprise arrays and software-defined storage.
* Real protocol depth, not product familiarity. iSCSI, NVMe over Fabrics, Fibre Channel, NFS and SMB. You should be able to explain what each one does and when you would choose it, independently of any vendor's console.
* Backup and restore ownership using Commvault or equivalent, including retention, compliance, and how a failure reaches a human.
* Pure Storage and NetApp, including snapshots and replication such as SnapMirror or FlashArray features.
* Disaster recovery you have designed or led, including the testing, not only participated in.
* Backup and storage for virtualized environments, VMware in our case.
* Performance troubleshooting: the ability to prove whether a problem is the storage, the host or the network, rather than assert that it is not yours.
* Scripting or automation for provisioning, reporting and restore verification.
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

How the team works
  
  

* You would join the IT Infrastructure team and work directly with platform engineering, the database organisation, security and the OEM vendors.
* On-call is a shared rotation, not a permanent state. Major incidents escalate to the whole team, and we would rather fix the cause than staff the symptom.
* We expect ownership rather than ticket-taking. If you find something broken outside your area, we would rather you said so than routed it.
* This role is a step toward storage and data platform architecture ownership as the Noida centre grows.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
  
  
**Benefits**
At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.
  
  
With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Manager/Senior Manager, Engineering - Observability and Monitoring
description:
We are looking for a senior Manager, Engineering for our Observability and Monitoring teams. Someone who can take ownership of two high-visibility teams building the operational backbone of SimCorp One, and who is ready to help define how we see, detect, and resolve issues across the company before clients feel them.
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
The AI & Insights area is building the foundation for reliable, intelligent operations of SimCorp's offerings. When something breaks in our systems, we need to know immediately, and our teams need to quickly be able to understand the root cause. Ideally, we see the signals in advance, initiate self-healing, and avoid interruptions for our clients. Observability and Monitoring are how we enable that.
  
  
The Observability team owns the data foundation: a standard, Open Telemetry-based way for every SimCorp system to emit logs, traces, and metrics, collected on a central Operational Data Platform that SREs, monitoring, and AI agents can all use. The Monitoring team owns what we do with that data: one governed monitoring standard with a single alert funnel, a standard alert payload, and one Grafana instance for dashboards and alert rules. Together, the two teams are the data and signal layer for AIOps: AI-assisted root-cause analysis, proactive resolution, and self-healing workflows.
  
  
You will partner closely with the Product Managers for Observability and Monitoring and with the architect to turn the roadmap into delivery, and you will report directly to the Senior Director of Engineering. You will also be part of the AI & Insights leadership team, contributing to the broader deliveries and growth of the area.
  
  
**What Will You Be Responsible For**
**Team leadership and development**

* Lead and grow the Observability and Monitoring teams, distributed across multiple locations, creating clear priorities and a supportive, engaged culture
* Develop individual engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, and honest feedbac
* Build one coherent engineering group across two domains, with the right composition, skills, and no single-person dependencies
* Hire and onboard new engineers into fast-moving workstreams as scope grows

**Delivery and operations**

* Own delivery of the Observability and Monitoring roadmaps
* Hold a high bar on quality, security, and operational readiness
* Manage day-to-day prioritisation, capacity, and engineering health across both teams, keeping delivery and engagement strong
* Remove blockers before they slow the team down, including the ones involving other teams

**Stakeholder and cross-team collaboration**

* Partner with the Product Managers to translate product strategy into an executable delivery plan
* Work with the architect on technology direction, from the OpenTelemetry data plane to the alerting and visualisation stack
* Collaborate with SREs, Operations, SaaS reliability, and the product development teams who instrument their code and consume the data, and translate technical work into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders
* Align with the Senior Director of Engineering on priorities and risks

**Strategy and growth**

* Help shape SimCorp's observability, monitoring, and AIOps strategy as scope expands from collecting data to automated root-cause analysis and self-healing
* Anticipate where the teams need to grow in skills, headcount, and tooling, and advocate for it
* Bring an informed point of view on measuring what matters, such as monitoring maturity, SLOs, and incident detection and resolution times, rather than coverage alone
* Make AI agents part of how the teams work and how SimCorp operates, with people orchestrating, reviewing, and holding the bar.

**What We Value**
**Ownership and independence**
You take responsibility without being told to, dig in when things are unclear, and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information and following through.
  
  
**Management experience**
You have led engineering teams before, ideally in a platform context, with a genuine track record of accountability for team outcomes and engagement.
  
  
**Technical grounding in observability and monitoring engineering**
You have a background in software or platform engineering and engage comfortably with telemetry (logs, traces, and metrics), instrumentation standards such as Open Telemetry, alerting, SLOs, and incident response. You are curious about how AI can speed up root-cause analysis and operations. You will not write production code, but you understand what your engineers build, ask the right questions, and spot when something is off.
  
  
**Communication clarity**
You write and speak in plain, precise English, can explain a complex platform decision to a non-technical stakeholder, and represent your team with confidence in senior forums.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Designation Data Engineer**
**Job Description**

* Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines using tools like Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, or AWS Glue to ingest, process, and transform large datasets from various sources, ensuring efficient data flow and processing.
* Design and implement data models and schemas in data warehouses (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery) and data lakes (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Data Lake) to support analytics and reporting needs.
* Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements, ensuring data availability and accessibility for analytics, machine learning, and reporting.
* Utilize ETL tools and frameworks (e.g., Apache NiFi, Talend, or custom Python scripts) to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes, ensuring data quality and integrity.
* Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance using tools like Apache Airflow or AWS Step Functions, implementing best practices for data processing and workflow management.
* Write, test, and maintain scripts in Python, SQL, or Bash for data processing, automation tasks, and data validation, ensuring high code quality and performance.
* Implement CI/CD practices for data engineering workflows using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, automating the deployment of data pipelines and infrastructure changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate data solutions into existing infrastructure, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or AWS CloudFormation for provisioning and managing resources.
* Manage containerized data applications using Docker and orchestrate them with Kubernetes, ensuring scalability and reliability of data processing applications.
* Implement monitoring and logging solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Stack to track data pipeline performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure data quality.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, security best practices, and data privacy regulations, embedding DevSecOps principles in data workflows.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to the development of best practices for data engineering, data quality, and DevOps methodologies.
* Mentor junior data engineers, providing guidance on data engineering practices, data architecture, and DevOps tools and techniques.
* Contribute to the documentation of data architecture, processes, and workflows for knowledge sharing, compliance, and onboarding purposes.
* Demonstrate strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including data science, analytics, and business stakeholders.

**Desired Profile**

* Seeking a DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on Cloud and DevOps experience, including significant leadership. Requires a Bachelor's/master’s in computer science.
* Must have expert proficiency in Terraform and extensive experience across at least two major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Helm charts, and designing/optimizing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) is essential. Proficiency in Python and scripting (Bash/PowerShell) is also a must.
* Valued experience includes leading cloud migrations, contributing to RFP/RFI processes, and mentoring teams. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills are critical. Experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and DevSecOps principles is required; OpenShift is a plus.

**Experience ; 8-10 years**
**Education : B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science**
**Technical Skills & Certifications**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, Google Professional Cloud Architect).
* Terraform, Kubernetes, Python, CI/CD, Ansible, Security tools, Monitoring tools.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: DevOps Engineer - Ansible Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Ansible Automation Engineer**

**Job Overview**

The Senior Ansible Automation Engineer will lead infrastructure automation initiatives, develop reusable automation frameworks, optimize deployment processes, and ensure compliance with enterprise security and infrastructure standards. The role requires extensive hands-on Ansible expertise, strong scripting capabilities, production troubleshooting experience, and the ability to provide technical guidance to engineering teams.

Location and Relocation Requirement: Candidates based in Noida or Delhi NCR who are willing to relocate to Mumbai may also be considered. Upon completion of the project requirement, they will be required to report to the Noida Head Office.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain complex Ansible playbooks, reusable roles, custom modules, and inventory structures for enterprise-scale automation.
* Lead infrastructure provisioning, system configuration, application deployment, and operational process optimization initiatives.
* Troubleshoot complex automation and production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Establish and enforce Infrastructure as Code practices, automation standards, code quality, security controls, and performance optimization.
* Integrate Ansible automation with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools to enable reliable, repeatable, and scalable deployments.
* Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance on Ansible and configuration management.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, DevOps, cloud, networking, and application teams to identify and implement automation opportunities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, automation frameworks, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ensure automation solutions comply with enterprise security policies, access controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure standards.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices to improve automation capabilities and operational efficiency.

**Candidate Profile**

* 8+ years of overall experience in IT infrastructure, automation, configuration management, or DevOps, with extensive hands-on Ansible expertise.
* Strong experience developing enterprise-grade Ansible playbooks, roles, inventories, and automation frameworks.
* Proficiency in Linux/Unix system administration, troubleshooting, and Bash shell scripting.
* Working knowledge of Python scripting for automation and integration.
* Hands-on experience with Git and version control workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent CI/CD platforms.
* Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment automation.
* Good knowledge of networking fundamentals, system security, access management, and infrastructure architecture.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot production issues and implement root-cause-based corrective actions.
* Demonstrated technical leadership, code review, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration experience.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, documentation, and prioritization skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ansible certification or relevant certifications in DevOps, Linux administration, automation, or cloud technologies.
* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Hands-on experience with Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, AWX, Ansible Tower, or similar enterprise automation solutions.
* Familiarity with Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK Stack.
* Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with security automation, compliance automation, and automated infrastructure testing.

title: Cloud Engineering Specialist
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
As a Cloud Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, deploy, and maintain cloud-based solutions primarily on the Microsoft Azure platform. The ideal candidate will also have a solid understanding of ETL processes and technologies, as well as experience with a variety of data sources. You will work closely with our clients, development teams, infrastructure teams, data & analytics team, and other stakeholders to ensure the successful implementation and operation of cloud services. Your role will involve designing and implementing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures, as well as troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise.
  
  
Additionally, you will work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting and industry experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution.
  
  
**Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to**
:
  
  

* The shift timings for this role is 5:00PM - 2:00AM IST (7:30AM - 4:30PM ET)
* Identify & map source data in various commercial and custom systems
* Design, develop, test and maintain ETL pipelines
* Extract, transform, and load data from a variety of data sources
* Work with data engineers and other stakeholders to define data requirements
* Troubleshoot and debug ETL pipelines
* Stay up-to-date on ETL technologies and best practices
* Formulate development estimates (task, effort, dependencies, etc.)
* Develop test cases and demonstrate results for assigned deliverables.
* Maintain and present daily/weekly status
* Articulate project deliverable details and activities to client and project team members
* Adapt to various industries and quickly learn the client’s context, language, and jargon to clearly document and translate business requirements to development plans
* Maintain a professional presence and be ready to interact with the client at all times
* Azure Solution Design: Collaborate with development teams and architects to design cloud-based solutions on the Azure platform. Evaluate requirements, propose design options, and recommend best practices for scalability, performance, security, and cost optimization.
* Azure Networking: Designing, implementing, and maintaining network infrastructure solutions based on Azure services i.e Configuring and managing virtual networks, subnets, routing tables, network security groups, and load balancers within the Azure environment, Configuring the IP-Sec VPN tunnels and troubleshooting network-related issues and providing timely resolution to minimize downtime.
* Azure Infrastructure Deployment: Deploy and configure Azure infrastructure components, such as virtual machines, storage accounts, virtual networks, load balancers and other azure services. Implement automation and infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) practices using tools like Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Azure Service Provisioning: Provision and manage Azure services, including but not limited to Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure SQL Database, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Active Directory (AAD).
* Monitoring and Troubleshooting: Set up monitoring and alerting mechanisms to ensure the health and performance of Azure resources. Investigate and resolve issues related to application availability, performance, and security. Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Security and Compliance: Implement and enforce security measures to protect Azure resources and data. Follow industry best practices and compliance standards. Conduct security assessments and vulnerability scans and implement necessary remediation actions.
* Backup and Disaster Recovery: Design and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies for Azure-based applications and data. Configure and manage Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and other relevant services.
* Collaboration and Documentation: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and support project delivery. Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, and deployment guides.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay up to date with the latest Azure features, services, and industry trends. Continuously explore and propose new solutions, tools, and methodologies to optimize cloud infrastructure, enhance security, and streamline operations.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* Strong experience in designing, implementing, and managing cloud solutions on the Azure platform (AWS and GCP is a plus)
* Previous consulting experience or experience working with external clients
* Strong understanding of ETL processes and technologies
* Experience with a variety of data sources, including relational databases, flat files, and web APIs
* Experience with Python, Java, or another programming language
* Experience with data warehouse technologies, such as Azure, AWS, and Snowflake
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills
* Strong communication and teamwork skills
* Solid understanding of software development life cycle models as well as expert knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit a project and business environment
* Technical background, with understanding or hands-on experience in enterprise solutions for different industries
* High-level knowledge of BI architecture or data warehousing
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Effectively managing multiple deliverables, clients and projects in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency in Azure services, including compute, storage, networking, and identity and access management (IAM).
* Proven experience in designing and implementing network infrastructure solutions in Microsoft Azure.
* Strong knowledge of Azure networking services, including virtual networks, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, Azure Firewall, and Azure Load Balancer.
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance standards related to cloud environments.
* Solid understanding of cloud architecture patterns, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code (IaaC) tools like ARM templates, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in Azure cloud environments ((AWS and GCP is a plus).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with teams and stakeholders.

**Key Stakeholders This Role Interacts With:**
**Internal**

* Senior BI Analyst
* Data Product Manager
* BI Architect / Senior Architect
* Data Engineers
* Analytics Developers (Power BI, Tableau)

**External**

* Clients Operations Leads and Mid-Level Managers
* Data Owners, Data Stewards
* Enterprise Information Management and Data Governance Team
* IT Staff – Architects, DBAs, Developers, etc

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer - I
description:
**Title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer- I : FinOps**
**Location: Noida, Hybrid**
Sumo Logic's FinOps team makes every dollar of cloud and AI spend visible, attributable and optimizable. As a Senior SRE, you'll apply SRE principles (measurement, observability, automation and accountability) to FinOps and cost optimization, treating cost the way SREs treat reliability. That means building, running and improving the tooling behind our cost decisions, from cost data pipelines and dashboards to unit-economics and allocation reporting. Beyond the tooling, you'll design new FinOps capabilities from concept through rollout and bring your technical expertise to cross-team cost-saving initiatives.

**What you will do:**

**FinOps tooling & cost observability**

* Build, maintain and improve FinOps tooling, including cost data pipelines, telemetry jobs, dashboards and reports across all Sumo Logic deployments.
* Implement and evolve unit-economics and cost-allocation reporting so cloud and AI spend maps accurately to the teams and products that drive it.
* Support and improve our cost regression program and tooling, detecting and investigating cost increases and helping teams resolve them.
* Support cross-team cost-saving initiatives, partnering with engineering teams to identify, implement and measure savings, and contribute to the cost optimization roadmap.
* Support commitment tracking (CSP, RI, EDP) with accurate coverage and utilization data.

**Applying SRE principles to FinOps**

* Run FinOps tooling and cost data pipelines like production services, with monitoring, alerting, data-quality checks and runbooks.
* Build actionable cost alerting and budget thresholds, modeled on SRE error budgets and burn-rate alerting.
* Automate manual cost reporting and analysis work.
* Design and implement new FinOps capabilities, from technical design through rollout.

**What you already have**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance or related field (Ph.D. is a plus)
* Comfortable with cost and unit-economics concepts (allocation, amortization, cost per unit), with the ability to turn complex data into actionable insights
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
* Track record of taking ownership and influencing results, working across internal and external organizations, including engineering, finance and marketing
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* **Technical skills**
  :

+ 3+ years of professional experience in data or software engineering roles
+ 1+ years of experience with cloud financial management or FinOps framework
+ Demonstrative ability to build and operate data pipelines with complex sources
+ Operational expertise in high scale, reliable 24/7, multi-tenant global SaaS
+ Strong coding and debugging skills (Scala experience highly beneficial)

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

title: Technical Solution Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
The candidate joins Cloud Domain Support team, focusing on Ericsson products like Cloud Execution Environment (CEE) and Cloud Container Distribution (ECCD). The team fosters continuous learning and knowledge sharing to deliver high customer satisfaction. This hire will resolve customer service requests (CSRs), troubleshoot complex virtualized infrastructure and container issues, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and maintain high network availability.
  
  
**What you will do:**
To investigate, troubleshoot, deliver remedy & restorations, and produce solutions to customer support tickets, CSRs (Customer Service Requests).
  
  
To work within well-defined system support guidelines.
  
  
To participate in software upgrades and updates.
  
  
Should be able to use support tools for ticket handling.
  
  
To ensure customer satisfaction with the performance of installed systems by successfully handling all reported technical problems.
  
  
Provide regular progress updates in the support system for each assigned support issue.
  
  
Through contact with external customers and internal support functions, gather data and information about any specific problem that has been reported.
  
  
Actively engage in communication with other engineers for the purpose of knowledge sharing etc.
  
  
Escalation of support tickets to next level of competence units if the CSR cannot be answered/solved within the time limit.
  
  
Evaluation of answers and solutions received from higher competence units to verify that the answer/solution will clear the problem reported by the customer.
  
  
In the line of supporting our products, identify possible improvements that make them more maintainable and user-friendly. Document these as Requirement Specifications as input to the design of new generations of the products.
  
  
Registration of new known solutions and updating of existing known solutions based on answers/solutions developed within own line organization or received from elsewhere.
  
  
Providing suggestions in developing Operation & Maintenance instructions.
  
  
Isolate product faults and raise them to Product Design. Support design unit to reproduce the fault and evaluate the final fix provided.
  
  
May need to work in shifts and Emergency Support rota.
  
  
To lead and execute the implementation of new software releases on test labs.
  
  
Writing documents for fault analysis/RCA along with required preventive and corrective actions.
  
  
Strong analytical skills.
  
  
24×7 availability as per support guidelines.
  
  
**The skills you bring :**
Relevant experience of 2-8 years .
  
  
Deep knowledge of Linux (SUSE/SLES, Red Hat/RHEL or Ubuntu) including extensive hands-on administration and troubleshooting (systemd, journald, networking, storage, performance).
  
  
Virtualization technologies (KVM/QEMU, libvirt).
  
  
Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash/Shell).
  
  
OpenStack knowledge and hands-on experience, OpenStack distribution (core services: Keystone, Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Heat).
  
  
Understanding of NFV/NFVI architecture and ETSI MANO concepts; VNF/CNF onboarding and VIM integration (e.g. with orchestrators such as EVNFM).
  
  
High-availability clustering (Pacemaker/Corosync), load balancing and virtual IP management (HAProxy, keepalived/VRRP).
  
  
Kubernetes administration and troubleshooting (control plane, kubelet, scheduling, RBAC, workloads) with hands-on operational experience.
  
  
Container runtimes (containerd, Docker) and image/registry handling.
  
  
Cluster lifecycle management on bare metal using Cluster API (CAPI) and Metal3, and cluster lifecycle tooling (e.g. ccdadm).
  
  
etcd operation, backup/restore and recovery fundamentals.
  
  
Kubernetes networking (Calico/CNI, Multus, kube-proxy) and policy enforcement (e.g. Kyverno).
  
  
Solid IP networking fundamentals (L2/L3, routing, VLANs, static routes, MTU, TLS/PKI troubleshooting).
  
  
Virtual machine and container internetworking concepts.
  
  
Open vSwitch (OVS) and OVS-DPDK.
  
  
SR-IOV functionality and DPDK-based high-performance networking.
  
  
Host network configuration tooling (NetworkManager/nmstate).
  
  
CEE: software-defined and cloud storage – OpenStack Cinder, Ceph, Nexenta, Dell Powerflex.
  
  
ECCD: Ceph and NetApp (CNIS deployments); ScaleIO/PowerFlex and Nexenta (NFVI-based deployments).
  
  
General block/object/file storage concepts.
  
  
Configuration management and automation (Ansible).
  
  
Orchestration templating (Heat/TOSCA).
  
  
Monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana; log aggregation such as Fluentd/Fluent Bit).

title: Tech Intern
description:
Job Title: Tech Intern (Software Engineering / Development)

Company: Multiplier AI Limited

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Job Type: Full-Time | Work from Office

Duration: 3 to 6 Months (Internship)

Total Experience Required: 0–1 Year (Freshers or candidates with prior tech internship/project experience preferred)

Stipend: ₹15,000 - ₹20,000 Monthly (Fixed Stipend + Performance Bonus)

Qualification: Pursuing or completed B.Tech / B.E. / BCA / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science, IT, or related technical disciplines

About the Role

Multiplier AI Limited is looking for an energetic, curious, and target-driven Tech Intern to join our Engineering & Product team in Noida.

In this role, you will assist in developing, testing, maintaining, and enhancing software applications across our technology stack. You will work closely with senior developers, technical leads, and product managers to write clean code, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to production-grade software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

This position is strictly focused on hands-on software development, coding, bug fixing, and technical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Software Development & Coding

- Write clean, maintainable, efficient, and well-documented code under the supervision of senior engineers.

- Assist in developing front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, or database scripts based on product requirements.

- Work with modern frameworks, libraries, and tools used within the company's tech stack.

- Participating in code reviews to receive constructive feedback and continuously improve coding standards.

2. Bug Fixing & Technical Support

- Identify, debug, and resolve software bugs, performance bottlenecks, and operational issues.

- Assist in writing unit test cases and integration tests to ensure system reliability and code quality.

- Participate in daily stand-ups, technical discussions, and sprint planning sessions with the engineering team.

- Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, or libraries to solve specific technical problems.

3. Documentation & Version Control

- Maintain and update technical documentation, API specifications, and architecture notes.

- Utilize version control systems (Git/GitHub/GitLab) for code deployment, branching, and collaboration.

- Track tasks, bugs, and project progress using project management tools (Jira, Trello, or similar).

4. System Architecture & Product Integration

- Assist in integrating third-party APIs, web services, and database modules.

- Collaborate with product design and UI/UX teams to build responsive and user-friendly web/mobile interfaces.

- Support deployment pipelines and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows.

Candidate Requirements

Mandatory

- Strong passion for software engineering, coding, and technology problem-solving.

- Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, or C#).

- Basic understanding of web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/React/Node.js) or database management (SQL / MongoDB).

- Familiarity with Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.

- Familiarity with Git/GitHub for version control.

- Excellent logical reasoning, analytical, and communication skills.

- Proactive attitude, quick learning ability, and willingness to adapt in a fast-paced environment.

- Available for full-time, in-office work at our Noida office.

Preferred

- Prior internship experience, open-source contributions, or personal project portfolio in software development.

- Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Cloud basics (AWS/GCP/Azure), or Docker containers.

- Degree (completed or pursuing) in B.Tech/B.E./MCA/BCA in Computer Science or Information Technology.

Compensation & Growth

- Monthly Stipend: ₹15,000 - ₹20,000 per month (Fixed Stipend + Performance-Linked Bonus)

- PPO Opportunity: Performance-based Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) for full-time employment upon successful completion of the internship.

title: Manager Software Engineering
description:

Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description: Job DescriptionLeads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.ResponsibilitiesKey ResponsibilitiesSystem Design & Architecture - System Scalability:–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.–Design performance and load testing.System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.Compliance & Security:–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.Automation & Change Management:–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.Core ResponsibilitiesPlanning & Execution:–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.Collaboration & Partnership:–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.Problem Solving:–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.Continuous Learning:–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.Continuous Improvement:–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.Performance and Development:–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.About UsOnly Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.
