title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Sr. DevOps Engineer (AI \& Automation)
 



  





**Location:** 
 Noida
 



  





**Experience:** 
 Min 3 Years
 




  





**Department:** 
 Engineering / Infrastructure \& Platform
 




  





**Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own our core DevOps administration while leading the
 



 implementation of AI\-driven development workflows. In this role, you will manage
 



 repositories, establish automated CI/CD pipelines, and design autonomous coding, testing,
 



 and code\-review agents using technologies like Claude Code, Anthropic Agent SDK, and
 



 GitHub Copilot Workspace/Agents. You will bridge classical platform engineering with AI
 



 native software development lifecycles.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. DevOps Administration \& Repository Management** 




**•** 
 Repository Architecture: Design, enforce, and maintain repository branching strategies
 



 (e.g., Trunk\-Based, GitFlow, Feature\-Branching) and access governance across
 



 organizations.
 



 • CI/CD Pipeline Engineering: Build, optimize, and secure multi\-environment
 



 deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps with caching
 



 and automated quality gates.
 



 • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform,
 



 Pulumi, or Bicep, ensuring zero\-drift environments.
 



 • DevSecOps Integration: Implement automated secret scanning (e.g., Gitleaks),
 



 dependency vulnerability checks (Trivy/Snyk), and SAST/DAST within CI steps.
 




  





**2\. AI Coding Agent Setup \& Branch Workflows** 




  





 • Coding Agent Deployment: Configure and orchestrate developer AI agents (e.g.,
 



 Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Cloud Agents, or custom agent frameworks) to perform
 



 autonomous task execution across different Git branches.
 



 • Repository Context \& Prompts: Author and maintain repository\-level context files
 



 (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, custom system prompts, and MCP server integrations) to
 



 steer agents toward project conventions and architecture patterns.
 



 • Multi\-Branch Automation: Configure workflow triggers that allow AI agents to pick up
 



 issue tickets, work within dedicated feature/bugfix branches, and automatically draft
 



 PRs.
 



  










**3\. Automated Code Review \& Testing Agents** 




  





 • Code Review Agents: Integrate automated AI code\-review agents within pull request
 



 workflows to perform compliance checks, security audits, and style adherence reviews
 



 before human sign\-off.
 



 • Automated Testing \& QA Agents: Build autonomous testing pipelines where agents
 



 analyze diffs, generate missing unit/integration tests, triage test failures, and suggest
 



 fixes directly in CI.
 



 • Governance \& Safeguards: Establish strict safety guardrails, execution sandboxes, and
 



 human\-in\-the\-loop approvals for agent\-generated code.
 



  





**Technical Qualifications** 




  





**Must\-Have Experience** 




  





 • Core DevOps (2\+ Years): Hands\-on expertise in CI/CD pipeline building, Docker,
 



 Kubernetes, and IaC (Terraform/Bicep/CloudFormation).
 



 • Git Administration: Mastery of Git internals, branch protection rules, merge strategies,
 



 and repository permissions.
 



 • AI Coding Tools \& SDKs: Proven experience configuring or extending GitHub Copilot
 



 (Copilot Workspace, Agent Mode, Custom Instructions/Skills) or Claude (Claude Code
 



 CLI, Anthropic API/SDK, Model Context Protocol).
 



 • Automation Languages: High proficiency in Python, Bash, or TypeScript/Node.js for
 



 building custom hooks, bots, and API integrations.
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have Experience** 




  





 • Experience building multi\-agent orchestrations (e.g., CrewAI, LangChain, or custom
 



 sub\-agents).
 



 • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server setups to connect AI agents with
 



 internal tooling, databases, and monitoring systems.
 



 • Deep understanding of DevSecOps standards and cloud infrastructure cost
 



 optimization.
 








**Expected 90\-Day Deliverables** 




  





 Month 1: Audit existing repos and establish standardized CI/CD templates and branch
 



 protection rules across all development projects.
 



 Month 2: Deploy initial Claude / GitHub Copilot agent workflows for automated PR code
 



 reviews and unit test generation.
 



 Month 3: Fully operationalize an end\-to\-end agentic workflow where feature tickets can be
 



 assigned to branch\-specific coding agents to generate, test, and submit initial pull requests.

title: Production Support Engineer
description:
We are hiring in Noida, India Only.
   

  

**About Ampliwork, Inc**
 Ampliwork builds Enterprise\-Grade AI Agents that amplify Human Potential™ to drive
   

  

 business productivity and growth since 2017\. Ampliwork’s AI Agents streamline complex
   

  

 multi\-step workflows in highly regulated industries such as Financial Services.
   

  

 Ampliwork builds and runs AI platforms for enterprise clients. Those platforms are in production, and the people using them need a reliable place to take questions, issues and requests. This is a new role, and it owns that first line of response.
   

  

 You take everything that arrives from client users, resolve what can be resolved, investigate what needs investigating, and pass to engineering only the items that genuinely require an engineer, complete and reproduced. Most of what comes in should be closed by you.
   

  

 The role covers several client deployments. Volumes vary by account and by week, so holding multiple contexts at once and prioritising sensibly across them is a central part of the job. Response and resolution targets are agreed with each client and vary by severity. We will walk through how that works at interview.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
****First response and first\-line resolution****
* Own the support queue end to end: acknowledge new requests promptly, classify them by severity, and drive every item to resolution or to a complete handoff.
* Answer usage and configuration questions directly, from the documentation and your own understanding of the product. A large share of inbound volume is not a defect: there are questions, workflow misunderstandings, enhancement ideas, and reports that turn out to be working as designed. Resolving those yourself is one of the main contributions of the role.
* Where the system behaviour is expected, walk the user through the correct workflow and close the loop with them. Where it is a defect, confirm that properly before escalating.
* Go back to the requester for whatever is missing, including screenshots, record references, steps to reproduce, timestamps and environment detail.


 Technical investigation and triage
   

  

* Carry out first\-level technical triage: inspect application and cloud logs, run read\-only database queries, reproduce the reported behaviour, and form your own view of the likely cause.
* Read application code well enough to locate the relevant logic and confirm or rule out a hypothesis.
* Work each ticket from more than one angle before drawing a conclusion, and recognise when you have reached the limit of what you can resolve on your own.
* Treat our internal AI triage tooling as a starting point rather than an answer. Check its classification and its suggested cause, correct it where it is wrong, and add your own findings.


**Escalation And Follow\-through**
* Escalate only the tickets that need it, with a reproducible case, logs, affected records, environment detail and your own analysis attached.
* Create and own the tasks sent downstream to the engineering team, then follow them through fix, review and release, and verify in production.
* Push back where a request sits outside agreed scope, and route it as an enhancement rather than letting it enter the queue as a defect.
* Judge when to ask for help. Flagging early is preferred to spending a day stuck on the same problem.


**Client Communication**
* Act as the named point of contact for client users, over email, the support portal and chat. You will be writing to experienced enterprise users, in some cases daily.
* Keep them informed at an agreed cadence, including regular status updates on high\-severity issues until they are resolved, whether or not there is progress to report.
* Tell clients plainly what is known, what is being done, and when they will next hear from you. Tickets should not go quiet.
* Hold your position courteously when a request is out of scope or a severity label is wrong, and know when to bring colleagues into the conversation.


**Knowledge, Reporting And Improvement**
* Contribute to the knowledge base as you go, covering known issues, workarounds, runbooks and standard responses, so that a repeat occurrence takes less work than the first. The work you do here will contribute directly to the skills of the triage AI Agent.
* Produce a weekly support report for each account, covering volume, mix, response performance, ageing, open high\-severity items and the recurring issues that warrant a permanent fix.
* Surface effort being spent outside agreed scope so that it can be reviewed.
* Give feedback on the triage tooling. Where its classification or draft replies are wrong, explain why, so that it can be improved rather than worked around.


**Essential**
****What we are looking for****
* Three to five years in application support, production support, technical support engineering, or a comparable client\-facing technical role.
* Python. Able to read and debug application code, and write small scripts to inspect data or verify behaviour.
* Cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent). Comfortable navigating logs and monitoring to trace an issue through a running system.
* SQL and PostgreSQL. Able to write your own queries to answer data\-level questions without waiting for someone else.
* A track record of resolving tickets rather than routing them. At interview we will ask you to talk through issues you closed yourself that others might have escalated.
* Excellent written English. Most of your output is writing, and much of it goes directly to a client. You will also regularly be on calls with client users, being able to explain how the system works using vocabulary that is relevant to client, is important.
* Self\-starting and methodical. You take notes, follow up on open items without being prompted, and keep track of everything that is outstanding.
* Comfortable being assertive. The role involves challenging a severity label, declining an out\-of\-scope request, and telling a client that what they are describing is not a defect.
* Able to carry several accounts and unrelated products at the same time, and to switch between them without losing track.
* Able to learn a complex domain application quickly. Our platforms carry substantial business logic, and supporting them well means understanding that logic rather than recognising screens.
* Comfortable being accountable for response times and for the client relationship, not only for ticket counts.


****Desirable****
* Experience working to defined service levels in enterprise, regulated or audited environments.
* Experience with an enterprise ticketing platform and a downstream engineering task tracker.
* Additional languages.
* Exposure to financial services, professional services, insurance, tax or transport operations.
* Experience working alongside AI agents or automation within a support workflow.


**How Success Is Measured**
****Horizon****
**What Good Looks Like**
 First 30 days
   

  

 You own the queue on your first account, acknowledge new requests within the agreed window, and classify severity correctly without help. Requests waiting on missing information are chased and moving.
   

  

 60 days
   

  

 Only the tickets that need an engineer reach engineering, and they arrive complete and reproduced. The weekly support report is running as a standing item, and the knowledge base covers the issues that recur.
   

  

 90 days
   

  

 The same model is running on a second account. You are proposing the product changes that would remove whole categories of ticket, and you own the support process itself, including intake, routing, escalation and client reporting.
   

  

 The headline measure is the proportion of inbound tickets resolved without engineering involvement.
   

  

****Tooling****
 Enterprise ticketing and task tracking, Microsoft 365, AWS (logs, monitoring and managed databases), PostgreSQL, Python, Git, and our internal AI triage tooling.

title: Systems Administration Senior Analyst
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Systems Administration Senior Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid\-level role involves independently managing end\-to\-end endpoint lifecycle operations — OS deployment, patch management, application delivery, and device compliance — for large global enterprise clients. The engineer will handle complex L2/L3 incidents, contribute to platform improvements, and serve as a reliable technical contributor within NTT DATA's EPM managed services practice supporting clients across US, APAC, and EMEA geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 OS Deployment \& Image Management
   

  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe\-and\-reload, and in\-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune\-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.


 Patch Management
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end patch management operations for SCCM\-managed and Intune\-managed endpoints across client accounts.
* Configure and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for monthly Microsoft Patch Tuesday cycles.
* Manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) rings, feature update policies, and quality update deferrals in Intune.
* Perform patch impact analysis, rollback planning, and emergency patching for zero\-day vulnerabilities.
* Generate and present patch compliance dashboards and exception reports to delivery leads and client stakeholders.
* Coordinate with security teams to address Qualys/vulnerability scan findings within SLA timelines.


 Application \& Software Management
   

  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.


 Infrastructure \& Platform Management
   

  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.


**Required Skills**
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, patch management, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co\-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client\-facing delivery and documentation

**The opportunity**
 AI Architect\- SC products: We are seeking an experienced Supply Chain AI Solution Architect to join our Digital Supply Chain Team. * Define AI security architectures addressing prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, jailbreak attempts, and AI\-specific threats.
* Ensure compliance with Responsible AI principles, privacy regulations, governance requirements, and security standards.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technical assessments, proof\-of\-concepts, and production\-readiness evaluations.
* Drive AI adoption across business and technology teams through workshops, technical leadership, and stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor AI engineers, architects, and developers while defining best practices, reusable frameworks, and reference architectures.
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends to drive continuous innovation.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related technology domains.
* Strong experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Hands\-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, context engineering, RAG, embeddings, reranking, and vector databases.
* Strong knowledge of AI agent architectures, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, memory strategies, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Proficiency in Python, API development, microservices architecture, and distributed systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI services.
* Strong understanding of databases, data platforms, event\-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Practical experience with MCP, REST APIs, JSON\-RPC, OAuth, and secure integration frameworks.
* Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, observability, LLMOps, and AI cost optimization.
* Understanding of model fine\-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, model routing, quantization, and inference optimization techniques.
* Experience with multimodal AI, knowledge graphs, GraphRAG, SQL agents, and advanced retrieval architectures.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, architecture documentation, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business outcomes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent orchestration platforms.
* Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Familiarity with vector databases and search platforms such as Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Neo4j.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, MLflow, vLLM, Langfuse, Ragas, DeepEval, and AI platform engineering practices.
* Understanding of AI governance and security frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, OWASP GenAI Security, ISO/IEC 42001, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience leading enterprise AI transformation initiatives, Centers of Excellence (CoE), or AI capability building programs.
* Exposure to MLOps, DataOps, and enterprise deployment strategies for scalable AI solutions.
* Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and presenting architecture roadmaps, AI strategies, and business cases.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

 Zero downtime deployments and a high availability mindset

title: Migration Architect
description:
SourceFuse is looking for a Cloud Migration Architect to lead clients through AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) engagements end\-to\-end, from discovery and assessment through Landing Zone setup, multi\-account governance, workload migration, and modernization.
 



 You'll own the migration roadmap for enterprise clients while ensuring security, cost,
 



 and operational posture keep pace with delivery.
 



  





**Experience Required \- 8\+ Years** 




**Preferred Location \- Noida/Mohali** 




  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Migration Strategy \& Execution:** 




 ●
 **MIGRATION DISCOVERY \& STRATEGY \-** 
 Lead AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) engagements — discovery, application portfolio assessment, and migration wave planning —
 



 to build a de\-risked, sequenced migration roadmap for enterprise clients.
 



 ●
 **WORKLOAD MIGRATION \& MODERNIZATION \-** 
 Execute migrations using AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), Database Migration Service (DMS) with Schema Conversion Tool (SCT),
 



 DataSync, and AWS Transform for AI\-assisted application and code modernization.
 



 ●
 **LANDING ZONE \& MULTI\-ACCOUNT ONBOARDING** 
 \- Stand up AWS Control Tower / Landing Zone (incl. Landing Zone Accelerator for HIPAA and other compliance\-driven environments), AWS
 



 Organizations, and Service Control Policies to onboard and govern client accounts.
 



**Governance, Security \& Optimization:** 




 ●
 **SECURITY \& COMPLIANCE** 
 \- Implement and manage security controls across IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, AWS WAF, and Network Firewall, ensuring migrated environments meet
 



 standards such as HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, and RBI where applicable.
 



 ●
 **COST OPTIMIZATION / FINOPS** 
 \- Analyze usage patterns and right\-size resources using Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, and Compute Optimizer; apply Reserved Instances / Savings Plans
 



 and cost allocation tagging to reduce spend across multi\-account environments.
 



 ●
 **INFRASTRUCTURE AS CODE, CI/CD \& DR** 
 \- Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform and CloudFormation, build CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline/CodeBuild/CodeDeploy or Jenkins) for
 



 repeatable deployments, and design disaster recovery plans against defined RTO targets.
 



  





**REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:** 




**Migration \& Cloud Foundation \-** 




 ● Migration Tooling \- AWS Migration Hub, Application Migration Service (MGN), DMS, SCT, DataSync, AWS Transform
 



 ● Landing Zone \& Governance \- Control Tower, Landing Zone Accelerator, AWS Organizations, Service Control Policies
 



 ● Compute \& Orchestration \- EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling
 



 ● Storage \& Database \- S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB, DocumentDB
 



 ● Networking \- VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, PrivateLink, ELB, CloudFront
 



  





**Security, Data \& Operations \-** 




 ● Security \& Identity \- IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Inspector, WAF, Network Firewall, KMS, IAM Identity Center (SSO), Okta, Cognito (CIAM)
 



 ● Analytics \& Event\-Driven \- Athena, EMR, Redshift, EventBridge, SNS, SQS
 



 ● Observability \& Monitoring \- CloudWatch, X\-Ray, and third\-party APM (New Relic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, SigNoz)
 



 ● Infrastructure as Code \- Terraform and AWS CloudFormation — reusable modules, automated deployment workflows
 



 ● Systems Administration \- server administration, hardening, and troubleshooting
 



  





**PREFERRED CERTIFICATIONS** 




 ● AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Professional / Associate
 



 ● AWS Certified Advanced Networking — Specialty
 



 ● AWS Certified Advanced Security — Specialty
 



  





**BONUS POINTS** 




 ● CONTAINER PLATFORMS \- Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerized workloads.
 



 ● COMPLIANCE FRAMEWORKS \- Experience supporting HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR, or RBI (banking) compliance requirements.
 



 ● EMERGING PRACTICES \- Exposure to FinOps, AIOps, AI\-assisted DevOps, MCP servers, or Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) leadership.
 



 ● MULTI\-CLOUD EXPOSURE \- Hands\-on migration experience moving workloads from Azure and/or GCP into AWS, plus rehosting on\-premises VMware vSphere/ESXi and Proxmox VE
 



 virtualized environments.
 



 ● GENAI ON AWS \- Exposure to Amazon Bedrock, Kendra, or Amazon Q for AI\-assisted client solutions.
 



 ● REGULATED INDUSTRY DELIVERY \- Proven delivery in Healthcare (HIPAA) and/or Banking \& Financial Services (RBI) environments.

title: Cloud Specialist
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
 We are looking for NOC Cloud Team lead who will have a unique blend of technical depth and leadership, where you will work on advanced private cloud infrastructures — spanning OpenStack administration, Linux systems management, and automation\-driven efficiencies — while also guiding a high\-performing team to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable cloud solutions. Beyond technical delivery, you will be expected to build strong customer relationships and uphold operational excellence, making this an ideal opportunity for someone who leads with both expertise and accountability.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Carry out OpenStack cloud administration, including performance tuning, troubleshooting, resource optimisation, availability zone configuration, tenant management, and host aggregation.
* Install, configure, monitor, and optimise Linux systems, both physical and virtual, including kernel tuning, LVM management, and the implementation of advanced security measures.
* Manage and maintain RHEL, Ubuntu, and CentOS operating systems, ensuring smooth upgrade processes.
* Configure and troubleshoot networking protocols and services, including TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, VLAN, VXLAN, routing, DNS, DHCP, bridging, and IP Tables.
* Operate hardware management interfaces such as iLO, iDRAC, and CIMC efficiently.
* Perform CEPH storage management activities, including OSD operations and cluster flag adjustments.
* Leverage automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, and Terraform for provisioning and configuration management.
* Develop automation scripts using Bash and Python to improve operational efficiency and service quality.
* Deploy and manage containerised applications using Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, ITSM guidelines, operational processes, and industry best practices.
* Work closely with stakeholders to deliver tailored cloud solutions and maintain strong client relationships.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to team members.
* Drive continuous improvement across cloud operations, automation, service reliability, and customer delivery.


**You will bring**
* At least 9 years of professional experience in private cloud technologies, particularly OpenStack and Linux administration.
* Experience in a combined technical and team leadership role.
* Red Hat OpenStack certification, along with RHCSA and RHCE certifications.
* Strong Linux administration expertise, including operating system optimisation, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in automation scripting using Bash and Python.
* Hands\-on experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, and Terraform.
* Working knowledge of SDN, NFV concepts, and microservices or container orchestration platforms.
* Advanced networking knowledge, including network configuration, troubleshooting, performance optimisation, and fault resolution.
* Experience managing hardware interfaces across enterprise systems, including iLO, iDRAC, and CIMC.
* Operational expertise in CEPH storage management.
* Strong understanding of OpenStack components, architecture, resource management, and troubleshooting.

**Job Description**
 The File \& Object Storage Engineering team delivers scalable, secure, and automated file and object storage platforms supporting enterprise application onboarding, data center builds, and rapid data growth across lines of business.
   

  

 The File and Object senior infrastructure engineer is tasked with the design, configuration, and ongoing engineering of the organization’s file storage platforms. This role requires the engineer to collaborate with application teams, assisting them in onboarding their applications to utilize file and object storage solutions. Additionally, the engineer provides support with data migrations and engages closely with vendors to facilitate enhancements and resolve technical issues.
   

  

 One of the key responsibilities of the engineer is to identify and implement automation opportunities that streamline daily activities. This includes provisioning, data migrations, and addressing security remediation asks. The engineer also serves as an escalation point for the operations team, providing expertise and guidance for complex issues.
   

  

 Key scope includes:
   

  

* Deliver end‑to‑end provisioning (file shares and object buckets) aligned to SLA targets and enterprise demand
* Support large‑scale onboarding, data migrations, and capacity expansion for new data centers and platforms
* Drive adoption of automation (API) to reduce manual workflows and improve TAT
* Enable standardized, policy‑driven provisioning and improve accuracy, governance, and reporting
* Support platform stability by resolving complex issues and acting as escalation point for provisioning and platform incidents
* Partner with architecture, security, and platform teams to support enhancements, certification, and long‑term platform evolution
* Contribute to improving customer experience by enabling self‑service, reducing rework, and simplifying workflows


 This role is critical to sustaining provisioning throughput, enabling data center expansion, and accelerating the shift toward automation‑first, API‑driven storage delivery.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 
+ 4–6 years of infrastructure or storage engineering experience
+ Experience supporting enterprise file and/or object storage platforms
+ Strong troubleshooting and operational support skills
+ Experience working in SLA‑driven environments


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 
+ Hands‑on experience with file and object storage provisioning and support
+ Experience managing provisioning requests, onboarding, and data migrations
+ Understanding of storage lifecycle (capacity, performance, lifecycle mgmt.)
+ Experience with scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Ansible)
+ Knowledge of OS (Linux/Windows) and networking fundamentals
+ Ability to handle L2/L3 escalation and drive issue resolution
+ Experience working with cross‑functional teams (app, infra, vendors)
+ Focus on improving TAT, reducing manual effort, and standardizing workflows


**Desired Qualifications**
* 
+ Experience with NetApp ONTAP and enterprise object storage platforms
+ Exposure to self‑service provisioning (IDP), APIs, and automation at scale
+ Familiarity with cloud storage platforms and container environments
+ Understanding of security, compliance, and governance in storage
+ Ability to contribute to automation improvements and operational initiatives
